# iXamBee

> > iXamBee is a comprehensive exam preparation platform for Indian banking, insurance, and government competitive exams including RBI, NABARD, IBPS, SSC, SEBI, and DSSSB.

The platform offers daily current affairs (BeePedia), free mock tests, online courses, and study materials in both English and Hindi. It specializes in preparing candidates for banking sector exams (RBI Grade B, NABARD Grade A, IBPS), insurance exams (UIICL, UIIC), and various government recruitment tests with comprehensive study resources and interview preparation.

## Key Topics

- IBPS (Institute of Banking Personnel Selection)
- RBI (Reserve Bank of India)
- NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development)
- RBI Grade B
- NABARD Grade A
- SEBI Grade A
- DSSSB (Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board)
- SSC (Staff Selection Commission)
- UIICL/UIIC (United India Insurance Company)
- BeePedia Current Affairs
- Banking Exams
- Government Exams
- Mock Tests
- Daily GK (General Knowledge)
- Competitive Exams

## Exam Information & Notifications

- [FSSAI Exam 2026: Apply Online for Technical Officer and Central Food Safety Officer (CFSO)](https://www.ixambee.com/exams/fssai): FSSAI 2026 exam info for Technical Officer & CFSO posts
- [UIICL Assistant](https://www.ixambee.com/exams/uiicl-assistant): UIICL Assistant exam notification, eligibility & dates
